Department of Computer Science
Welcome to the Department of Computer Science in the College of Engineering at North Carolina A&T State University, where we are shaping the next generation of computer scientists to thrive in the dynamic and rapidly evolving world of modern computing.
In today’s digital era, computing extends far beyond traditional programming—it is about innovation, problem-solving and the creative engineering of intelligent systems that drive technological advancements. Our curriculum is designed to equip students with cutting-edge knowledge and hands-on experience in emerging fields such as artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning, cybersecurity, data science, game design, robotics, software engineering, and computational intelligence.
With AI revolutionizing industries—from healthcare and finance to autonomous systems and smart cities—our students are at the forefront of this transformation, gaining the skills necessary to become leaders in the field. Whether you aspire to develop intelligent algorithms, secure critical infrastructure, design immersive gaming experiences, or pioneer breakthroughs in robotics, our programs will provide the foundation and opportunities to help you excel.
Join us and be part of an exciting journey where innovation meets impact. The future of computing is here, and it starts with you!
Kaushik Roy, Ph.D.
Department Chair and Professor
Computer Science Department
North Carolina Agricultural & Technical State University
